provenance.parsing: Liver and lesion: dataset reference masks; muscle: automated named-muscle segmentation; fat: CT intensity estimate
provenance.dynamics: Separate frozen rule-contract illustration; not a fitted patient forecast

muscle.label: Muscle
muscle.scope: Visible named abdominal and posterior muscle groups; not complete skeletal muscle
muscle.reference_priority: Existing liver and lesion masks take precedence; exclude zero-filled exterior padding

fat.label: Fat
fat.method: Body-constrained CT intensity threshold with conservative morphological filtering
fat.processing: Exclude lower-bound saturation and its one-voxel in-plane interface; exclude muscle/liver/lesion; in-plane opening; remove components below 16 voxels
fat.scope: Display estimate on preprocessed cropped CT; no SAT/VAT subdivision or fat-volume measurement
